g.text: Evidence C: SELECTED SUCCESSFUL CASE, chosen retrospectively for illustration; not representative of all dates
Timing: each target date shows its own next-day (+1 day) forecast, issued after the previous day's observations (inputs = the 32 preceding days). The
three dates are three separate forecasts, NOT a +1/+2/+3-day forecast from one origin.
Model: deployed GALE-CAST Model-W1 (SHA-256 f2db5aa9…9d14b0), historical scoring procedure (pooled scaled_weather inputs); X1 = mean of the three
stations' scores on the date; warning if X1 ≥ 0.601. GALE-CAST Model-W1 values are neural-only outputs (no MOS, no blending).
Baselines: persistence = observation of the issue day; climatology = station × calendar-month mean of raw observations, 2015-01-01 to 2020-10-14.
Event persistence = study label of the issue day. Study label: wind ≥ 10.8 m/s OR same-station 24-hour MSLP fall ≥ 3 hPa.
Station: Sangley Point (primary). Dates: 2023-04-18 to 2023-04-20; n = 3 station-days. Selection: spec/CASE_SELECTION_v1.md (E1-E3; ranked by correct
decisions in the window [chosen for correct warnings, disclosed], then pressure fall, then date); GALE-CAST Model-W1 error relative to baselines was
NOT used to select. Observations: PAGASA; panel review export. Run case-20261025T163757Z-91e616.
